title: Failure resolution lifecycle center
summary: Rebuilt Reports failure triage into a backend-authored Failure Resolution Center with lifecycle state, playbook steps, verification facts, timeline evidence, preview-first marker clearing, and advanced evidence archive wiring.
reason: The previous table-first failure view exposed too many row-level buttons and did not give operators a clear path to acknowledge, work, verify, resolve, or safely clear current failure markers.
behavior_before: Reports > Failures centered on a raw table with repeated row-level actions, limited grouping context, and cleanup controls that were visually separate from issue resolution.
behavior_after: Reports > Failures presents grouped issues with one primary action, lifecycle controls, backend-authored playbook and verification panels, journal-backed operator progress, preview-first marker clearing, and a gated evidence archive flow.
